name: gore
description: Author Gothic 1 Remake dialogs, voice and mod bundles, compile AngelScript offline, or safely manage GORE and external mods.

interface.shortDescription: Author, compile, inspect, and safely manage G1R mods
interface.longDescription: Guides an agent through dialog, voice and bundle authoring, read-only validation, and the complete Mod Manager lifecycle for GORE and external mods: import, enable, order, analyze, preflight, apply, status, recovery, removal and reset. Strict standalone AngelScript compilation and bundle inspection run offline without game-launch consent; occupied work trees, protected outputs, and real game or install mutations remain confirmed. The plugin bundles the MCP server configuration; current facts live in the guide shipped inside gore.exe. Needs the gore CLI installed and on PATH.
defaultPrompt: Build me a test mod for Gothic 1 Remake so I can see modding works.
Import these Gothic 1 Remake mods, check their conflicts, apply them safely, and show me how to reset.
